banner.title: Privacy & Data Consent
banner.intro: Before using RATi OS, please review how we handle your data. This service is operated by <company>Cenetex Inc.</company>.

walletIdentity.title: Wallet & Identity
walletIdentity.desc: We collect your wallet address and, if you use email login, your email. Session metadata (IP, User-Agent) is stored for 24 hours.

aiConversations.title: AI Conversations
aiConversations.desc: Your chat messages are sent to third-party AI providers (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI GPT-4 via OpenRouter) for response generation. Media prompts are sent to Replicate.

blockchainData.title: Blockchain Data
blockchainData.desc: We query Solana RPC providers (Helius) using your wallet public key to verify NFT ownership.

connectedServices.title: Connected Services
connectedServices.desc: If you connect Telegram, Twitter, or Discord, message content is shared with those platforms via their APIs.

storageRetention.title: Storage & Retention
storageRetention.desc: Chat history is auto-deleted after 24 hours. AI memories are tiered: ephemeral (1 day), durable (90 days), and archival (permanent until avatar deletion). Audit logs are kept for 1 year. Account and identity records are retained until you delete your account. Depending on the data type, retention is enforced through TTLs, lifecycle rules, or deletion workflows.

policy.title: Privacy Policy
policy.overviewP1: <company>Cenetex Inc.</company> ("we," "us," or "our") operates the RATi Avatar System ("RATi OS") at <domain>swarm.rati.chat</domain>, which lets users create and interact with AI avatars on the Solana blockchain.
policy.overviewP2: RATi OS is built on open-source software licensed from the <foundation>RATi™ Open Software Foundation</foundation>, a not-for-profit organization. Cenetex Inc. is the data controller responsible for your personal data as described in this policy.
policy.overviewP3: This Privacy Policy explains what data we collect, how we use it, who we share it with, and your rights.
policy.authIdentityWalletAddressesDesc: your Solana public key(s), collected on every login.
policy.authIdentityEmailAddressesDesc: if you sign in via Privy (email/social).
policy.authIdentitySessionMetadataDesc: IP address, User-Agent, and timestamps stored in session records (24-hour TTL).
policy.conversationsChatMessagesDesc: messages you send to avatars. Admin chat sessions are stored in DynamoDB with a default 24-hour TTL.
policy.avatarMemoriesIntro: AI-generated summaries of interactions, stored across three tiers:
policy.avatarMemoriesArchivalDesc: permanent, summary-only (no TTL; retained until avatar deletion).
policy.canonicalMemoriesDesc: consolidated memory records with a default 30-day TTL.
policy.extractedFactsDesc: structured facts derived from conversations, auto-deleted after 90 days.
policy.systemPromptsPersonaDataDesc: avatar configuration you create or edit.
policy.nftOwnershipStatusDesc: we check whether your wallet holds Orb collection NFTs to determine feature access.
policy.generatedWalletKeypairsDesc: if an avatar has an auto-generated wallet, the private key is stored encrypted in AWS Secrets Manager (KMS).
policy.generatedMediaDesc: images, video, and audio created by avatars. Temporary media is deleted after 1 day; other media transitions to cost-optimized storage after 30 days.
policy.contentStoreDesc: drafted/posted/rejected social media content. Posted content is retained for 90 days, rejected content for 7 days, and pending content for 30 days.
policy.auditLogsDesc: records of administrative actions (avatar creation, updates, secret changes, entitlement changes), retained for 365 days (1 year) in DynamoDB.
policy.applicationLogsDesc: structured logs in AWS CloudWatch. Message processing logs are retained for 30 days; admin and other service logs are retained for 14 days. Operational logs are intended to store metadata rather than message content, but troubleshooting reports or feedback you submit may include text you provide.
policy.apiAccessLogsDesc: API Gateway request logs, retained for 30 days.
policy.activityRecordsDesc: avatar activity tracking events, auto-deleted after 24 hours.
policy.localStorageConsentDesc: your privacy policy acceptance status and version.
policy.useDataAuthenticate: Authenticate your identity and manage sessions.
policy.useDataConversations: Deliver AI avatar conversations and maintain chat context.
policy.useDataNft: Check NFT ownership for gating features.
policy.useDataMemories: Generate and store AI memories across retention tiers.
policy.useDataMedia: Generate images, video, and audio content via AI models.
policy.useDataAbuse: Detect abuse and enforce rate limits.
policy.useDataAudit: Record audit trails for administrative actions.
policy.useDataReliability: Debug issues and improve platform reliability.
policy.sharingIntro: We share data with the following third-party services as necessary to operate the platform:
policy.sharingOpenRouterNote: (routes to Anthropic Claude, OpenAI GPT-4, and other models)
policy.sharingOpenRouterData: Conversation history (context window), system prompts, avatar persona
policy.sharingSocialApisPurpose: Platform integrations (only if you connect them)
policy.sharingAwsPurpose: Infrastructure (DynamoDB, Lambda, S3, CloudWatch, Secrets Manager, SQS)
policy.sharingNoSell1: We do not sell your data.
policy.sharingNoSell2: We do not use your conversations to train our own AI models.
policy.sharingNoSell3: Third-party AI providers may process your data according to their own privacy policies.
policy.retentionIntro: Retention periods are enforced through a combination of automatic TTL-based deletion in DynamoDB, lifecycle policies in S3 and CloudWatch, and explicit deletion workflows. Data that expires automatically is marked “auto-deleted” below. Account records, identity links, consent records, and archival memories do not carry a TTL and are retained until you delete your account or avatar, or submit a deletion request.
policy.securityEncryptedTransit: All data in transit is encrypted via TLS (HTTPS enforced).
policy.securityEncryptedAtRest: DynamoDB data is encrypted at rest with AES-256 (AWS-managed keys).
policy.securitySecretsManager: Secrets (API keys, wallet private keys) are stored in AWS Secrets Manager with KMS encryption.
policy.securityOperationalLogging: Operational logging is designed to minimize stored content, though troubleshooting reports or feedback you submit may include text you provide.
policy.securityTelegramWebhook: Telegram webhook handlers verify secret tokens and validate sender IP against Telegram's official IP ranges.
policy.securityWalletSignatures: Wallet signatures are verified using Ed25519 (SIWS — Sign In With Solana).
policy.securityPartitionIsolation: Each avatar's data is isolated from other avatars through partition-key isolation in DynamoDB.
policy.securityDependencies: Dependencies are audited for known vulnerabilities in CI; high/critical severity findings block deployment.
policy.rightsAccessDesc: request a copy of the data we hold about you.
policy.rightsDeletionDesc: request deletion of your personal data. Most operational data auto-expires via TTL; account records, identity links, and consent records are retained until you request deletion and are removed within 30 days of a request.
policy.rightsPortabilityDesc: request your data in a machine-readable format.
policy.rightsWithdrawDesc: revoke your consent at any time (this does not affect the lawfulness of prior processing).
policy.rightsContact: To exercise any of these rights, contact us at <email>privacy@cenetex.com</email>.
policy.cookiesIntro: We do not use third-party tracking cookies. The following client-side storage is used:
policy.cookiesConsentDesc: records your privacy policy acceptance (version accepted and timestamp). Required for consent management.
policy.cookiesAuthDesc: authentication and account metadata (for example login state, linked account details, and gate status) plus temporary OAuth flow data for cross-tab communication. Session cookies remain HttpOnly cookies and are not stored in localStorage.
policy.cookiesOutro: You can clear all localStorage data via your browser settings. Clearing consent storage will require you to re-accept this policy.
policy.aiDisclosureP1: When you interact with an avatar, your messages (along with recent conversation context) are sent to third-party AI model providers via OpenRouter, which routes to models such as Anthropic Claude and OpenAI GPT-4, for response generation. These providers may process your data according to their own privacy policies. We do not use your conversations to train our own models.
policy.aiDisclosureP2: Media generation (images, video, audio) is performed via Replicate. Prompts and input media are sent to Replicate's API for processing.
policy.childrenP1: RATi OS is not intended for users under 18 (or the age of majority in your jurisdiction, whichever is greater). We do not knowingly collect data from minors. If you believe a minor has provided us data, please contact us at <email>privacy@cenetex.com</email>.
policy.changesP1: We may update this policy from time to time. If we make material changes, we will increment the policy version number and re-prompt for your consent within the application. The current policy version is displayed in the consent banner and at the bottom of this page.
